final: WITH s AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry AS z, si.entrystat AS st, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS a FROM sites si JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s), sa AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS sav FROM s WHERE st IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st), k AS (SELECT s.a AS a, base.b AS b, sa.sav AS sav FROM s JOIN sa ON s.st = sa.st CROSS JOIN base WHERE s.a > sa.sav) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept, AVG(a - b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - sav) AS avg_excess_over_status FROM k
